notes.title: Achievements & Demo
notes.content:
Following my previous announcement about testing them, achievements should now be working properly! They're mostly pretty straightforward to get, but if you're stuck, you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2216078049]consult the official guide[/url]. If you encounter any issues unlocking achievements when following those instructions, feel free to email me at parttimestorier@gmail.com and I'll see if I can figure out what the problem is.

Also, a page for the demo of [i]The Light at the End of the Ocean[/i] has also been approved! The demo, which is the same one I released on a different platform back when the game was still in development, will be available on steam before the end of the month.

Thanks for reading, and have fun unlocking the achievements!
